claim_text: Attacks in the Strait of Hormuz have pushed oil toward $100 a barrel despite a build in US crude inventories, with Middle East tensions keeping prices elevated in trading reported on 16 August 2026.
quote: Hormuz Attacks Push Oil Toward $100 Despite US Crude Build
confidence_justification: Price direction is observable market data, but the causal attribution to Hormuz attacks is the outlet's framing.
